description: This file defines the ContentOptionsDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of content options in OrchardCore CMS, including rendering views and handling form data.

classes.name: ContentOptionsDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for managing content options UI in OrchardCore, handling display, edit, and update operations.

methods.name: BuildPrefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix for form binding to 'Options'.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Builds the display view for content options, including bulk actions and filters.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Prepares the model for editing by mapping filter results and initializing various UI components.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Maps form post data back into the filter result and delegates to EditAsync.

methods.name: BuildContentOptionsViewModel
methods.description: Copies properties from the main model to a view model for UI rendering.
